data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 per the technical provisions movements table was approximately GBP 267.3m. The report does not present a clearly labelled GROSS prioryear movement figure in the movement note that could be unambiguously extracted; therefore a gross prior year development amount could not be determined from the available pages. The 2017 results were materially impacted by 2017 natural catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, cited together at ~GBP 111.1m of losses) which contributed to the underwriting loss for the year.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding obtained from the 'Claims provisions / movements' table (At 1 January 2017 gross = 267,287; page 44). The report does not contain a clearly labelled GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure that could be unambiguously extracted from the available images; the movement note / reconciliation and the claims development table are present but not legible enough to compute the gross prior year development per the instruction rules. A net/summary figure could not be safely identified; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. Named 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey/Irma/Maria) are explicitly mentioned; the c.GBP 111.1m figure appears in the narrative but the document does not make clear if that number is gross or net-I have treated it as cited loss amount with moderate confidence. Premium mix tables were not legible enough to extract exact regulatory class labels and amounts.
